ComingSoon.title: Get a client’s sign-off on the whole month from one WhatsApp link.
ComingSoon.body: We’re getting Signo ready for marketing agencies in Egypt and the Gulf. Stay tuned.

Auth.pitch: Get your clients' approval with one link.
Auth.point1: Clients review and approve from their phone, no account needed.
Auth.point2: Track every post: approved, waiting, or needs changes.
Auth.point3: A clear record of who approved what, and when.
Auth.foot: For marketing agencies in Egypt and the Gulf

Auth.countryHint: Sets the timezone and price list
Auth.languageHint: Default language for the agency and your account
